article.title: Three senators defect to APC at plenary
article.text: Three senators from the South, Senator Tonye Ebiere-Dappa (Bayelsa Demo District 1), Senator Chinedu Okoroafor-Eze (Imo Demo District 1) and Senator Ifiok Udoaka-Essien (Akwa Ibom Demo District 1), on Tuesday defected from the Peoples Democratic Party to the All Progressives Congress. The Senate President read their letters during plenary.
